Priyanka Gandhi Criticizes PM Modi Over Youth Protest Crackdown

Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi regarding the handling of youth protests. She urged the Prime Minister to "change the angle of your heart" instead of "the camera angle." Gandhi's remarks came in response to the crackdown on protesters.
